* Data collectors: From school drop outs regarding their willingness to continue their studies and causes of their dropping out. 50 from each district
* Motivators: Motivating poor parents to send their children to school. 50 from each district
* Teachers: for school beginners from poor families: 50 from each district
* Assistants for children's Libraries cum Child Centres to be established in each district: 20 for each district

Application dead line: 20 March, 2016

Qualification: Only students of class IX and X can apply

A testimonial from the Head Teacher is required.
